archive_template_source.label: Archive template from
archive_template_source.explanation: Reuse the archive template of another post type or taxonomy. A theme file named archive-{post_type}.php always wins over this.

single_template_source.label: Single template from
single_template_source.explanation: Reuse the single template of another post type. A theme file named {post_type}.php always wins over this.

inherit_metas.label: Inherit meta boxes from post types
inherit_metas.explanation: Every meta box attached to the selected post types also shows up here, no need to edit each field library. Changes on the source apply instantly.

fullAccess.label: Select user roles with full edit access

semiAccess.label: Select user roles with restricted edit access

template_source.label: Archive template from
template_source.explanation: Reuse the archive template of another post type or taxonomy. A theme file named taxonomy-{taxonomy_name}.php always wins over this.

template.label: Template path
template.explanation: if you create ewp_{taxonomy_name}.php it will be used. Otherwise use path (from plugins/ or themes/). If none archive.php will be used.

inherit_metas.label: Inherit meta boxes from taxonomies
inherit_metas.explanation: Every meta box attached to the selected taxonomies also shows up here, no need to edit each field library. Changes on the source apply instantly.

show_results.label: The dom element to show the results (like #primary, .main-content > div)

run_on_load_empty.label: Execute on page load even if form is empty
